_notes: Early-writer $LMNS rewards (zero-seed launch). Off-chain points from indexed Writer Pool events; the owner pays each week from an unsigned export he signs (scripts/rewards/writer-payout.ts). The code never holds a key or sends tokens.

tokenAddress: empty until $LMNS exists. While empty the program shows 'Rewards start when $LMNS launches'. The SAME address must be in web/dist/launch.json and web/dist/writer-rewards.json (a test checks all three agree).
startAt: the start of reward week 1 (ISO UTC). Set it together with tokenAddress. Week n runs [startAt + 7(n-1) days, startAt + 7n days).

tokenTotalSupply and weeklyPoolBpsOfSupply: the weekly pool is 0.1% (10 bps) of the total supply. Default supply 1,000,000,000 gives 1,000,000 LMNS a week. If the real supply differs, set tokenTotalSupply to it and the pool scales to 0.1% of it.
weeks: the program runs 8 weekly periods, then the owner reviews it.
perWalletCapBps: one wallet receives at most 10% of a week's pool. Its share above that is not paid (it stays with the owner) unless redistributeOverCap is true.
minTimeWeightedUsdg: a wallet qualifies only if its deposits still in the pool averaged at least 1,000 USDG over the week (time-weighted).

projectWallets: the operator wallets from docs/runbooks/mainnet-addresses.json; never eligible. EXCLUDED_WALLETS: more wallets that are never eligible (the owner's personal and developer wallets); starts empty. Lemniscate contract addresses (deployment file), the zero address and contract wallets are excluded too.
